Metode kineziološkega raziskovanja II¶

**Skripta je bila napisana s pomočjo generativne umetne inteligence (OpenAI; Codex Različica 26.1029.61003)*

Povzetek¶

Podatkovna zbirka vsebuje podatke pridobljene iz 10 različnih indijskih bolnišnic, kjer so zbrali podatke 541 žensk. Napovedna spremenljivka, PCOS (Y/N) je binarna in daje informacijo ali je bila pacientka diagnosticirana s sindromom policističnih jajčnikov (PCOS). Poleg napovedne spremenljivke je bilo zbranih še 41 drugih spremenljivk (31 numeričnih in 10 kategorijskih). To je bolezen za katero je značilen skupek simptomov in bolezenskih znakov pri povišanih vrednostih androgenov pri ženski. Sindrom policističnih jajčnikov nastane zaradi prepleta genetskih in okolijskih dejavnikov. Med dejavnike tveganja spadajo debelost, pomanjkanje telesne dejavnosti ter pojavljanje bolezni v družini.

V sklopu predmeta MKR II smo želeli s pomočjo podatkov definirati več modelov strojnega učenja, jih primerjati in s pomočjo SHAP analize ugotoviti kateri faktorji imajo največjo napovedno vrednost v modelu.

Podatkovno bazo smo najprej pregledali in počistili, nato smo generirali Tabelo 1 in graf razporeditve napovedne spremenljivke. Zbirko smo nato stratificirano razdelili na učno in testno množico, in podatke ustrezno predobdelali (standardizacija numeričnih podatkov in OneHotEncoding kategorijskih podatkov). Nato smo definirali 10 različnih napovednih modelov (LOGREG, KNN SVC, MLP, DecisionTree AdaBoost, LightGBM, GradientBoosting, RandomForest in XGBoost). Vsakega od modelov smo definirali v privzetih nastavitvah, opravili pa smo tudi optimizacijo hiperparametrov (z uporabo 5-fold navzkrižne validacije). Zmogljivost modelov na podlagi metrik natančnosti, senzitivnosti, specifičnosti, F1 in ROC AUC smo izvedli na testni množici. Pripravili smo tudi izris ROC AUC krivulje za vse modele in razlike med modeli preverili s parnim bootstrap-om in Holm-ovo korekcijo. Po preučitvi vrednosti metrik smo v končno SHAP analizo vključili štiri modele; Logistično regresijo, XGBoost, Gradient Boosting in RandomForest. Vsi štirje modeli so se pri svojih napovedih najbolj opirali na število foliklov v levem in desnem jajčniku ter na nekatere značilne simptome PCOS.

In [12]:
categorical = ['Blood Group', 'Cycle(R/I)', 'Pregnant(Y/N)', 'Weight gain(Y/N)', 'hair growth(Y/N)', 'Skin darkening (Y/N)', 
               'Hair loss(Y/N)', 'Pimples(Y/N)', 'Fast food (Y/N)', 'Reg.Exercise(Y/N)']

continuous = [' Age (yrs)', 'Weight (Kg)', 'Height(Cm) ', 'BMI', 'Pulse rate(bpm) ', 
              'RR (breaths/min)', 'Hb(g/dl)', 'Cycle length(days)', 'Marraige Status (Yrs)', 
              'No. of aborptions', '  I   beta-HCG(mIU/mL)', 'II    beta-HCG(mIU/mL)', 
              'FSH(mIU/mL)', 'LH(mIU/mL)', 'FSH/LH', 'Hip(inch)', 'Waist(inch)', 
              'Waist:Hip Ratio', 'TSH (mIU/L)', 'AMH(ng/mL)', 'PRL(ng/mL)', 
              'Vit D3 (ng/mL)', 'PRG(ng/mL)', 'RBS(mg/dl)', 'BP _Systolic (mmHg)',
              'BP _Diastolic (mmHg)', 'Follicle No. (L)', 'Follicle No. (R)',
              'Avg. F size (L) (mm)', 'Avg. F size (R) (mm)', 'Endometrium (mm)']

non_normal = []
for c in continuous:
    stat, p = kstest(df[c], 'norm')
    if p < 0.05:
        non_normal.append(c)

table = TableOne(
    data=df,
    columns=continuous + categorical,
    categorical=categorical,
    groupby=target,
    nonnormal=non_normal, 
    pval=True,
    overall=False,
    missing=True,
    htest_name=True
)

print(table.tabulate(tablefmt="fancy_grid"))
table.tableone.to_csv("PCOS_table_one_tableone.csv")

Komentar: Iz tabele 1 je razvidno kateri kazalniki so statistično značilno različni med skupinama (PCOS/no PCOS). Tabela nam torej da začetni vpogled kateri kazalniki bi lahko imeli večjo napovedno vrednost (p < 0.05): Age, weight, BMI, pulse rate, Hb, cycle length, marriage status, FSH, FSH/L2, Hip, Waist, AMH, Follicle No. (leva in desna), Avg. Follicle Size (leva in desna), Endometrium, Cycle regularity, weight gain, hair growth, skin darkening, hair loss, pimples, fast food. S pomočjo tabele si lažje predstavljamo, katere značilke bodo imele večjo napovedno vrednost v modelih strojnega učenja.

Komentar: Vidimo, da je podatkovna baza precej dobro uravnotežena (vsaj bolje kot v primeru predstavljenim na predavanjih; DSWI=4.9% noDSWI=95.1%), zato smo se odločili, da ne bomo dodajali sintetičnih podatkov.

Naslednji koraki:

  1. stratificirana razdelitev na učno in testno množico (70% : 30%),
  2. predobdelava z OneHotEncoding, skaliranjem in imputacijo manjkajočih vrednosti (median za skalarje in najpogostejša vrednost za kategorične),
  3. optimizacija hiperparametrov,
  4. primerjava napovedne vrednosti modelov; ne-optimiziranih in optimiziranih.

numeric_transformer = Pipeline([
    ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="median")),
    ("scaler", StandardScaler())
])

categorical_transformer = Pipeline([
    ("imputer", SimpleImputer(strategy="most_frequent")),
    ("encoder", OneHotEncoder(
        handle_unknown="ignore",
        sparse_output=False
    ))
])

preprocessor = ColumnTransformer([
    ("num", numeric_transformer, continuous),
    ("cat", categorical_transformer, categorical)
])

In [61]:
QUICK_RUN = True
REUSE_SAVED_TUNING = True
N_SEARCH_ITERATIONS = 5 if QUICK_RUN else 30
CV_FOLDS = 3 if QUICK_RUN else 5
SEARCH_N_JOBS = 1  

tuning_cv = StratifiedKFold(
    n_splits=CV_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=RANDOM_STATE
)

tuned_models = {}
search_objects = {}
test_probabilities = {}
comparison_rows = []
best_parameters = {}
all_cv_results = []

saved_tuning_files_exist = all([
    Path('model_comparison_tuned_test_results.csv').exists(),
    Path('model_comparison_all_cv_results.csv').exists(),
    Path('model_comparison_best_parameters.json').exists(),
])

if REUSE_SAVED_TUNING and saved_tuning_files_exist:
    print('Reusing saved full-search hyperparameters and refitting the ten best pipelines.')
    with open('model_comparison_best_parameters.json', encoding='utf-8') as parameter_file:
        best_parameters = json.load(parameter_file)
    saved_comparison = pd.read_csv('model_comparison_tuned_test_results.csv')
    saved_cv_results = pd.read_csv('model_comparison_all_cv_results.csv')
    comparison_rows = saved_comparison.drop(columns='CV_rank', errors='ignore').to_dict('records')
    all_cv_results = [saved_cv_results]

    for model_name, (estimator, _) in models.items():
        restored_parameters = best_parameters[model_name].copy()
        if model_name == 'MLP' and isinstance(restored_parameters.get('hidden_layer_sizes'), list):
            restored_parameters['hidden_layer_sizes'] = tuple(restored_parameters['hidden_layer_sizes'])
        restored_pipeline = Pipeline([
            ('preprocessor', clone(preprocessor)),
            ('model', clone(estimator)),
        ])
        restored_pipeline.set_params(**{
            f'model__{key}': value for key, value in restored_parameters.items()
        })
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.simplefilter('ignore', ConvergenceWarning)
            warnings.simplefilter('ignore', FutureWarning)
            restored_pipeline.fit(X_train, y_train)
        tuned_models[model_name] = restored_pipeline
        test_probabilities[model_name] = restored_pipeline.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    models_to_search = {}
else:
    models_to_search = models

for model_number, (model_name, (estimator, parameter_distributions)) in enumerate(models_to_search.items(), start=1):
    print(f'[{model_number}/{len(models)}] Tuning {model_name} ...', flush=True)
    model_pipeline = Pipeline([
        ('preprocessor', clone(preprocessor)),
        ('model', clone(estimator)),
    ])

    search = RandomizedSearchCV(
        estimator=model_pipeline,
        param_distributions=parameter_distributions,
        n_iter=N_SEARCH_ITERATIONS,
        scoring='roc_auc',
        cv=tuning_cv,
        refit=True,
        random_state=RANDOM_STATE,
        n_jobs=SEARCH_N_JOBS,
        return_train_score=True,
        error_score='raise',
    )

    start_time = time.perf_counter()
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter('ignore', ConvergenceWarning)
        search.fit(X_train, y_train)
    elapsed_seconds = time.perf_counter() - start_time

    best_model = search.best_estimator_
    y_pred = best_model.predict(X_test)
    y_probability = best_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    tn, fp, fn, tp = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred, labels=[0, 1]).ravel()

    cv_results = pd.DataFrame(search.cv_results_)
    cv_results.insert(0, 'Model', model_name)
    all_cv_results.append(cv_results)

    cleaned_parameters = {
        key.replace('model__', ''): (value.item() if isinstance(value, np.generic) else value)
        for key, value in search.best_params_.items()
    }
    best_parameters[model_name] = cleaned_parameters
    tuned_models[model_name] = best_model
    search_objects[model_name] = search
    test_probabilities[model_name] = y_probability

    comparison_rows.append({
        'Model': model_name,
        'CV_ROC_AUC_mean': search.best_score_,
        'CV_ROC_AUC_SD': cv_results.loc[search.best_index_, 'std_test_score'],
        'CV_train_ROC_AUC': cv_results.loc[search.best_index_, 'mean_train_score'],
        'Test_ROC_AUC': roc_auc_score(y_test, y_probability),
        'Test_accuracy': accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred),
        'Test_balanced_accuracy': balanced_accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred),
        'Test_sensitivity': recall_score(y_test, y_pred, pos_label=1),
        'Test_specificity': recall_score(y_test, y_pred, pos_label=0),
        'Test_precision': precision_score(y_test, y_pred, zero_division=0),
        'Test_F1': f1_score(y_test, y_pred),
        'TN': tn, 'FP': fp, 'FN': fn, 'TP': tp,
        'Fit_seconds': elapsed_seconds,
    })

    print(
        f"    CV AUC={search.best_score_:.3f}; "
        f"test AUC={comparison_rows[-1]['Test_ROC_AUC']:.3f}; "
        f"time={elapsed_seconds:.1f}s", flush=True
    )

    # Checkpoint after every model so a long run can be resumed/debugged safely.
    pd.DataFrame(comparison_rows).to_csv(
        'model_comparison_tuned_test_results_partial.csv', index=False
    )
    pd.concat(all_cv_results, ignore_index=True, sort=False).to_csv(
        'model_comparison_all_cv_results_partial.csv', index=False
    )
    with open('model_comparison_best_parameters_partial.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as parameter_file:
        json.dump(best_parameters, parameter_file, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

comparison_results = (
    pd.DataFrame(comparison_rows)
    .sort_values('CV_ROC_AUC_mean', ascending=False)
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)
comparison_results.insert(0, 'CV_rank', np.arange(1, len(comparison_results) + 1))
all_tuning_results = pd.concat(all_cv_results, ignore_index=True, sort=False)

comparison_results.to_csv('model_comparison_tuned_test_results.csv', index=False)
all_tuning_results.to_csv('model_comparison_all_cv_results.csv', index=False)
with open('model_comparison_best_parameters.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as parameter_file:
    json.dump(best_parameters, parameter_file, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

comparison_model_order = comparison_results.sort_values('CV_rank')['Model'].tolist()
default_models = {}
default_test_probabilities = {}
default_test_predictions = {}
tuned_test_predictions_050 = {}

for model_name in comparison_model_order:
    default_pipeline = Pipeline([
        ('preprocessor', clone(preprocessor)),
        ('model', clone(default_estimators[model_name])),
    ])
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter('ignore', ConvergenceWarning)
        warnings.simplefilter('ignore', FutureWarning)
        default_pipeline.fit(X_train, y_train)
    default_probability = default_pipeline.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    default_models[model_name] = default_pipeline
    default_test_probabilities[model_name] = default_probability
    default_test_predictions[model_name] = (default_probability >= 0.50).astype(int)
    tuned_test_predictions_050[model_name] = (
        test_probabilities[model_name] >= 0.50
    ).astype(int)

DEFAULT_VS_TUNED_BOOTSTRAPS = 2000
default_vs_tuned_rng = np.random.default_rng(RANDOM_STATE + 5000)
test_outcome_array = np.asarray(y_test, dtype=int)
test_class_indices = [
    np.flatnonzero(test_outcome_array == class_value) for class_value in [0, 1]
]
default_vs_tuned_bootstrap_indices = []
for _ in range(DEFAULT_VS_TUNED_BOOTSTRAPS):
    sample_index = np.concatenate([
        default_vs_tuned_rng.choice(indices, size=len(indices), replace=True)
        for indices in test_class_indices
    ])
    default_vs_tuned_rng.shuffle(sample_index)
    default_vs_tuned_bootstrap_indices.append(sample_index)

def default_vs_tuned_metrics(y_true, probability, prediction):
    return {
        'Accuracy': accuracy_score(y_true, prediction),
        'F1': f1_score(y_true, prediction, zero_division=0),
        'ROC_AUC': roc_auc_score(y_true, probability),
    }

comparison_records = []
configuration_predictions = {
    'Default': (default_test_probabilities, default_test_predictions),
    'Tuned': (test_probabilities, tuned_test_predictions_050),
}
for model_name in comparison_model_order:
    for configuration, (probability_map, prediction_map) in configuration_predictions.items():
        probability = np.asarray(probability_map[model_name], dtype=float)
        prediction = np.asarray(prediction_map[model_name], dtype=int)
        point_metrics = default_vs_tuned_metrics(
            test_outcome_array, probability, prediction
        )
        bootstrap_values = {metric: [] for metric in point_metrics}
        for sample_index in default_vs_tuned_bootstrap_indices:
            sample_metrics = default_vs_tuned_metrics(
                test_outcome_array[sample_index],
                probability[sample_index],
                prediction[sample_index],
            )
            for metric, value in sample_metrics.items():
                bootstrap_values[metric].append(value)

        record = {'Model': model_name, 'Configuration': configuration}
        for metric, point_estimate in point_metrics.items():
            lower, upper = np.percentile(bootstrap_values[metric], [2.5, 97.5])
            record[metric] = point_estimate
            record[f'{metric}_CI_lower'] = lower
            record[f'{metric}_CI_upper'] = upper
        comparison_records.append(record)

default_vs_tuned_results_raw = pd.DataFrame(comparison_records)

def format_default_vs_tuned_estimate(row, metric):
    return (
        f"{row[metric]:.3f} "
        f"({row[f'{metric}_CI_lower']:.3f} to {row[f'{metric}_CI_upper']:.3f})"
    )

formatted_rows = []
for model_name in comparison_model_order:
    row = {'Model': model_name}
    model_results = default_vs_tuned_results_raw.query('Model == @model_name')
    for metric in ['Accuracy', 'F1', 'ROC_AUC']:
        for configuration in ['Default', 'Tuned']:
            result = model_results.query(
                'Configuration == @configuration'
            ).iloc[0]
            row[f'{metric}: {configuration} (95% CI)'] = (
                format_default_vs_tuned_estimate(result, metric)
            )
    formatted_rows.append(row)

default_vs_tuned_table = pd.DataFrame(formatted_rows)
display(default_vs_tuned_table)

default_vs_tuned_results_raw.to_csv(
    'model_comparison_default_vs_tuned_with_95CI_raw.csv', index=False
)
default_vs_tuned_table.to_csv(
    'model_comparison_default_vs_tuned_with_95CI.csv', index=False
)

Komentar: V tabeli lahko primerjamo sposobnost napovedovanja ne-optimiziranih in optimiziranih modelov. Iz tabele je razvidno, da večina modelov dobro oziroma zelo dobro diskriminira med razredoma ne glede na to, ali je bil model optimiziran ali ne. Če gledamo samo ROC AUC vrednosti, ki podajo splošno diskriminacijsko sposobnost modelov, vidimo, da se pri 7 od 10 modelih ROC AUC vrednost zviša. Največji dvig in sicer za dobre 4 odstotne točke vidimo pri modelu K-NN. Sposobnost diskriminacije pa se z optimizacijo modela ni nujno izboljšala. Modelom GradientBoosting, XGBoost in RandomForest modelu se z optimizacijo parametrov napovedna sposobnost ni spremenila ali pa se je deloma znižala. Vsi modeli so bili testirani na isti testni množici. Za accuracy in F1 smo uporabili klasifikacijski prag 0,50. Za vsako metriko smo izračunali 95% interval zaupanja s stratificiranim bootstrapom, ki je vključeval 2000 ponovitev. Vsi modeli imajo precej visoko ROC AUC oceno, vendar bomo za nadaljno analizo uporabili RandomForest, GradientBoosting, XGBoost in LOGREG. LOGREG bo uporabljena kot osnovni model, ki smo ga želeli izboljšati.

Najbolje torej bolne paciente zaznavata XGBoost in LightGBM. Najvišjo specifičnost pa imajo K-NN, LOGREG in GradientBoosting. Ti trije modeli pa zaznajo najmanj lažno pozitivnih primerov. Izbira najbolj primernega modela torej zavisi od stroškov zdravljenja in resnosti (smrtnosti) bolezni. Če so stroški zdravljenja veliki, si želimo čim manj lažno pozitivnih pacientk (visoka specifičnost), če pa je bolezen precej smrtonosna želimo čim manj spregledanih pozitivnih (visoka senzitivnost).

ROC_AUC_BOOTSTRAPS = 2000
ROC_AUC_BOOTSTRAP_SEED = RANDOM_STATE + 7000
roc_auc_model_order = (
    comparison_results.sort_values('Test_ROC_AUC', ascending=False)['Model'].tolist()
)
roc_auc_y = np.asarray(y_test, dtype=int)
roc_auc_class_indices = [
    np.flatnonzero(roc_auc_y == class_value) for class_value in [0, 1]
]
roc_auc_rng = np.random.default_rng(ROC_AUC_BOOTSTRAP_SEED)
roc_auc_bootstrap_indices = []
for _ in range(ROC_AUC_BOOTSTRAPS):
    sample_index = np.concatenate([
        roc_auc_rng.choice(indices, size=len(indices), replace=True)
        for indices in roc_auc_class_indices
    ])
    roc_auc_rng.shuffle(sample_index)
    roc_auc_bootstrap_indices.append(sample_index)

roc_auc_point_estimates = np.empty(len(roc_auc_model_order))
roc_auc_bootstrap_distribution = np.empty(
    (ROC_AUC_BOOTSTRAPS, len(roc_auc_model_order))
)

for model_index, model_name in enumerate(roc_auc_model_order):
    probability = np.asarray(test_probabilities[model_name], dtype=float)
    roc_auc_point_estimates[model_index] = roc_auc_score(roc_auc_y, probability)
    for bootstrap_index, sample_index in enumerate(roc_auc_bootstrap_indices):
        roc_auc_bootstrap_distribution[bootstrap_index, model_index] = roc_auc_score(
            roc_auc_y[sample_index], probability[sample_index]
        )

roc_auc_model_rows = []
for model_index, model_name in enumerate(roc_auc_model_order):
    lower, upper = np.percentile(
        roc_auc_bootstrap_distribution[:, model_index], [2.5, 97.5]
    )
    roc_auc_model_rows.append({
        'Model': model_name,
        'ROC_AUC': roc_auc_point_estimates[model_index],
        'CI_lower': lower,
        'CI_upper': upper,
    })
roc_auc_model_results = pd.DataFrame(roc_auc_model_rows)
roc_auc_model_table = pd.DataFrame({
    'Model': roc_auc_model_results['Model'],
    'ROC AUC (95% CI)': roc_auc_model_results.apply(
        lambda row: (
            f"{row['ROC_AUC']:.3f} "
            f"({row['CI_lower']:.3f} to {row['CI_upper']:.3f})"
        ),
        axis=1,
    ),
})
print('ROC AUC of tuned models on the held-out test set:')
display(roc_auc_model_table)

roc_auc_pairwise_rows = []
for first_index in range(len(roc_auc_model_order)):
    for second_index in range(first_index + 1, len(roc_auc_model_order)):
        difference_distribution = (
            roc_auc_bootstrap_distribution[:, first_index]
            - roc_auc_bootstrap_distribution[:, second_index]
        )
        lower, upper = np.percentile(difference_distribution, [2.5, 97.5])
        lower_tail = (np.sum(difference_distribution <= 0) + 1) / (
            ROC_AUC_BOOTSTRAPS + 1
        )
        upper_tail = (np.sum(difference_distribution >= 0) + 1) / (
            ROC_AUC_BOOTSTRAPS + 1
        )
        roc_auc_pairwise_rows.append({
            'Model_A': roc_auc_model_order[first_index],
            'Model_B': roc_auc_model_order[second_index],
            'ROC_AUC_A': roc_auc_point_estimates[first_index],
            'ROC_AUC_B': roc_auc_point_estimates[second_index],
            'Difference_A_minus_B': (
                roc_auc_point_estimates[first_index]
                - roc_auc_point_estimates[second_index]
            ),
            'CI_lower': lower,
            'CI_upper': upper,
            'Bootstrap_p': min(1.0, 2 * min(lower_tail, upper_tail)),
            'CI_excludes_zero': bool(lower > 0 or upper < 0),
        })

roc_auc_pairwise_results = pd.DataFrame(roc_auc_pairwise_rows)
raw_p_values = roc_auc_pairwise_results['Bootstrap_p'].to_numpy()
p_value_order = np.argsort(raw_p_values)
ordered_p_values = raw_p_values[p_value_order]
holm_ordered = np.maximum.accumulate(
    (len(raw_p_values) - np.arange(len(raw_p_values))) * ordered_p_values
)
holm_ordered = np.clip(holm_ordered, 0, 1)
holm_adjusted = np.empty_like(holm_ordered)
holm_adjusted[p_value_order] = holm_ordered
roc_auc_pairwise_results['Holm_adjusted_p'] = holm_adjusted
roc_auc_pairwise_results['Statistically_significant'] = (
    roc_auc_pairwise_results['CI_excludes_zero']
    & (roc_auc_pairwise_results['Holm_adjusted_p'] < 0.05)
)
roc_auc_pairwise_results['Higher_ROC_AUC_model'] = np.where(
    roc_auc_pairwise_results['Statistically_significant'],
    np.where(
        roc_auc_pairwise_results['Difference_A_minus_B'] > 0,
        roc_auc_pairwise_results['Model_A'],
        roc_auc_pairwise_results['Model_B'],
    ),
    '',
)

significant_auc_differences = (
    roc_auc_pairwise_results
    .loc[roc_auc_pairwise_results['Statistically_significant']]
    .sort_values('Holm_adjusted_p')
    .copy()
)
print(
    f"Statistically significant ROC AUC differences after Holm correction: "
    f"{len(significant_auc_differences)} of {len(roc_auc_pairwise_results)} pairs."
)
if significant_auc_differences.empty:
    print('No pairwise ROC AUC difference met both significance criteria.')
else:
    significant_auc_table = pd.DataFrame({
        'Model A': significant_auc_differences['Model_A'],
        'Model B': significant_auc_differences['Model_B'],
        'ROC AUC A': significant_auc_differences['ROC_AUC_A'].map(lambda x: f'{x:.3f}'),
        'ROC AUC B': significant_auc_differences['ROC_AUC_B'].map(lambda x: f'{x:.3f}'),
        'Difference (95% CI)': significant_auc_differences.apply(
            lambda row: (
                f"{row['Difference_A_minus_B']:.3f} "
                f"({row['CI_lower']:.3f} to {row['CI_upper']:.3f})"
            ),
            axis=1,
        ),
        'Holm-adjusted p': significant_auc_differences['Holm_adjusted_p'].map(
            lambda x: f'{x:.4f}'
        ),
        'Higher ROC AUC': significant_auc_differences['Higher_ROC_AUC_model'],
    })
    display(significant_auc_table)

roc_auc_model_results.to_csv(
    'model_comparison_test_roc_auc_with_95CI.csv', index=False
)
roc_auc_pairwise_results.to_csv(
    'model_comparison_test_roc_auc_pairwise_significance.csv', index=False
)

roc_auc_p_matrix = pd.DataFrame(
    np.nan, index=roc_auc_model_order, columns=roc_auc_model_order
)
for _, row in roc_auc_pairwise_results.iterrows():
    roc_auc_p_matrix.loc[row['Model_A'], row['Model_B']] = row['Holm_adjusted_p']
    roc_auc_p_matrix.loc[row['Model_B'], row['Model_A']] = row['Holm_adjusted_p']
np.fill_diagonal(roc_auc_p_matrix.values, 1.0)

heatmap_mask = np.tril(np.ones_like(roc_auc_p_matrix, dtype=bool), k=-1)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 9))
sns.heatmap(
    roc_auc_p_matrix, mask=heatmap_mask, annot=True, fmt='.3f',
    cmap='rocket_r', vmin=0, vmax=0.10, linewidths=0.5,
    cbar_kws={'label': 'Holm-adjusted paired-bootstrap p-value'}, ax=ax
)
ax.set_title('Statistical comparison of test ROC AUC between tuned models')
ax.set_xlabel('')
ax.set_ylabel('')
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.yticks(rotation=0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(
    'model_comparison_test_roc_auc_significance_heatmap.png',

)

import shap
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

SHAP_BACKGROUND_SIZE = min(40, len(X_train))
SHAP_EXPLANATION_SIZE = min(100, len(X_test))
SHAP_PERMUTATIONS = 3

best_four_models = [
    'Random Forest', 'Gradient Boosting', 'XGBoost', 'Logistic Regression'
]
print('Models selected for SHAP analysis:', ', '.join(best_four_models))

background_indices, _ = train_test_split(
    np.arange(len(X_train)), train_size=SHAP_BACKGROUND_SIZE,
    stratify=y_train, random_state=RANDOM_STATE + 3000
)
explanation_indices, _ = train_test_split(
    np.arange(len(X_test)), train_size=SHAP_EXPLANATION_SIZE,
    stratify=y_test, random_state=RANDOM_STATE + 3001
)
X_shap_background = X_train.iloc[background_indices].copy()
X_shap_explain = X_test.iloc[explanation_indices].copy()
y_shap_explain = y_test.iloc[explanation_indices].copy()

feature_name_replacements = {
    'Marraige Status (Yrs)': 'Marriage Status (yrs)',
    'hair growth(Y/N)': 'Hair growth (Y/N)',
    'Weight gain(Y/N)': 'Weight gain (Y/N)',
    'Pimples(Y/N)': 'Pimples (Y/N)',
    'Fast food (Y/N)': 'Fast food (Y/N)',
}
original_feature_names = X_train.columns.tolist()
display_feature_names = [
    feature_name_replacements.get(str(name).strip(), str(name).strip())
    for name in original_feature_names
]

def pipeline_probability_function(fitted_pipeline):
    def predict_probability(values):
        frame = pd.DataFrame(values, columns=original_feature_names)
        return fitted_pipeline.predict_proba(frame)[:, 1]
    return predict_probability

shap_explanations = {}
shap_masker = shap.maskers.Independent(
    X_shap_background.to_numpy(), max_samples=SHAP_BACKGROUND_SIZE
)
maximum_evaluations = SHAP_PERMUTATIONS * (2 * X_train.shape[1] + 1)

for model_number, model_name in enumerate(best_four_models, start=1):
    print(f'[{model_number}/{len(best_four_models)}] Calculating permutation SHAP for {model_name} ...',
          flush=True)
    explainer = shap.Explainer(
        pipeline_probability_function(tuned_models[model_name]),
        shap_masker,
        algorithm='permutation',
        feature_names=display_feature_names,
        seed=RANDOM_STATE,
    )
    shap_explanations[model_name] = explainer(
        X_shap_explain.to_numpy(),
        max_evals=maximum_evaluations,
        batch_size=50,
        silent=True,
    )

X_shap_export = X_shap_explain.copy()
X_shap_export.insert(0, target, y_shap_explain.to_numpy())
X_shap_export.to_csv('shap_explanation_sample.csv', index=True)
np.savez_compressed(
    'shap_values_best_four_models.npz',
    **{model_name.lower().replace(' ', '_'): shap_explanations[model_name].values
       for model_name in best_four_models}
)

Komentar: Iz SHAP-grafov lahko razberemo, kateri kazalniki imajo največji vpliv na napovedi posameznega modela in v katero smer vplivajo nanje. Če primerjamo rezultate vseh štirih modelov, opazimo, da so med najpomembnejšimi kazalniki predvsem Follicle No. (R and L), Weight Gain, Cycle (R/I), Hair Growth, Pimples in Skin Darkening.

Modeli se torej pri svojih napovedih najbolj opirajo na število foliklov v levem in desnem jajčniku ter na nekatere značilne simptome PCOS. Iz grafov je razvidno, da prisotnost mozoljev, povečane poraščenosti, nerednega menstrualnega cikla, povečanja telesne mase in temnenja kože povečuje verjetnost, da bo model posameznico uvrstil v pozitivni razred. Podobno velja tudi za število foliklov, saj večje število foliklov v levem in desnem jajčniku prispeva k napovedi pozitivnega razreda. Čeprav se modeli med seboj nekoliko razlikujejo glede pomembnosti posameznih kazalnikov, se pri klasifikaciji večinoma opirajo na podobne značilke.

Zaključek: Glede na trenutne rezultate bi v primeru klasifikacije med bolniki z ali brez PCOS uporabili optimizirano logistično regresijo, saj ima najvišje vrednosti natančnosti, specifičnosti in F1. Prav tako je bistveno lažje razložljiva kot ostali trije modeli. Koeficiente lahko predstavimo kot razmerje obetov s 95% intervalom zaupanja. Razmerje obetov pove kolikokrat sespremenijo obeti za PCOS ob spremembi posameznega kazalnika.

V primeru, da bi model uporabljali za presejanje, kjer želimo spregledati čim manj bolnic, imata XGBoost in LightGBM pri pragu 0,50 nekoliko višjo senzitivnost; 0,830 proti 0,792, zato bi lahko uporabili katerega od njiju.
